name: GET /api/dunning/overdue input: attempts per tenant and status
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, status_cd AS status_cd, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(attempt_no) AS max_attempt FROM dunning_attempts GROUP BY tenant_id, status_cd

name: dunning attempts per invoice, ordered (pkg_dunning reads by invoice)
source_sql: SELECT invoice_id AS invoice_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dunning_attempts GROUP BY invoice_id ORDER BY invoice_id

name: notifications per kind
source_sql: SELECT kind_cd AS kind_cd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM notifications GROUP BY kind_cd

name: billing audit log entries per module (the swallowed-exception trail)
source_sql: SELECT module AS module, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing_audit_log GROUP BY module
